summary:
Implementation plan for integrating:
1. Visual Image Search (upload or live camera capture with Gemini multimodal matching).
2. AI Sales Specialist (floating assistant widget on all pages with product recommendations, instant search, and inquiry handling).
3. Contact segment hardening with direct owner contact channels (WhatsApp pre-fill & Resend email message dispatch).
4. Image rendering optimization (blurDataURL placeholders, progressive loading, priority caching).
